shopify.title: 🛍️ Shopify — how to connect
shopify.subtitle: 5 minutes, directly from your store admin — no external approval needed.

step1.title: Open your store settings
step1.desc: Log in to your Shopify admin, then go to: Settings → Apps and sales channels.

step2.title: Develop an app
step2.desc: In the top right, click « Develop apps », then « Create an app ». Give it a name, e.g. « SAMII OS ».

step3.title: Configure permissions
step3.desc: In the « Configuration » tab, click « Configure » under « Admin API integration », then check these scopes (read + write): Products, Orders, Customers, Inventory, Shipping, Order fulfillment.

step4.title: Install the app
step4.desc: Save, go to the « API credentials » tab, then click « Install app » in the top right (confirm the install).

step5.title: Copy your token
step5.desc: Still in « API credentials », under « Admin API access token », click « Reveal token once » and copy it immediately — Shopify will never show it again.

shopify.warn: This token gives access to your store — only share it with SAMII, and if you lose it, reinstall the app to generate a new one.

whatsapp.title: 💬 WhatsApp Business — how to connect
whatsapp.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Create a Green API account
step1.desc: Go to green-api.com and create a free account.

step2.title: Create a WhatsApp instance
step2.desc: In your dashboard, click « Create instance », choose « WhatsApp ».

step3.title: Scan the QR code
step3.desc: From WhatsApp on your phone (Settings → Linked devices), scan the QR code shown to link your number.

step4.title: Copy your credentials
step4.desc: Copy the « Instance ID » and « API Token » shown in your dashboard, then paste them into the connection form.

whatsapp.warn: These credentials give access to your WhatsApp account — only share them with SAMII.

telegram.title: ✈️ Telegram — how to connect
telegram.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Open the SAMII bot
step1.desc: Search for @SAMII_OGBot on Telegram, or click t.me/SAMII_OGBot.

step2.title: Send the /id command
step2.desc: The bot instantly replies with your personal Chat ID.

step3.title: Copy the Chat ID
step3.desc: Paste that number into the « Your Telegram Chat ID » field above to connect Telegram.

meta.title: 📘 Facebook / Instagram — how to connect
meta.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Click « Continue with Facebook/Instagram »
step1.desc: You'll be redirected to the Meta login page.

step2.title: Log in and authorize SAMII
step2.desc: Choose the page or account to connect, then accept the requested permissions.

step3.title: Done
step3.desc: You're automatically returned to this page — your card now shows « Connected ».

woocommerce.title: 🛒 WooCommerce — how to connect
woocommerce.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Click « Create my store »
step1.desc: SAMII redirects you to your own WordPress/WooCommerce site.

step2.title: Authorize access
step2.desc: Log in to your WooCommerce admin if needed, then click « Approve » to authorize SAMII.

step3.title: Automatic return
step3.desc: You're brought back to SAMII — your orders, products and stock sync automatically.

ccp.title: 🏦 CCP — how to connect
ccp.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Get your CCP statement ready
step1.desc: Account holder name, account number, and key (last 2 digits).

step2.title: Fill in the form
step2.desc: Enter this information on the CCP connection page.

step3.title: Verification
step3.desc: Our team verifies and activates your account before payments start arriving.

ccp.warn: This information is only used to receive your payments — it is never shared.

discord.title: 🎮 Discord — how to connect
discord.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Create a Discord application
step1.desc: Go to the Discord Developer Portal (discord.com/developers/applications), click « New Application ».

step2.title: Add a bot
step2.desc: In the « Bot » tab, click « Add Bot », then « Reset Token » to generate your token.

step3.title: Invite the bot to your server
step3.desc: In « OAuth2 → URL Generator », check « bot », then use the generated link to add it to your server.

step4.title: Copy the token
step4.desc: Paste the bot token and your server name into the connection form.

transporteur.title: 🚚 Carriers & messaging — how to connect
transporteur.subtitle: Follow these steps to connect this tool to SAMII.

step1.title: Log in to your account
step1.desc: On your carrier or messaging platform's site (Yalidine, DHL, WhatsApp Business...).

step2.title: Get your API key
step2.desc: Look under « API » or « Developer » settings in your account.

step3.title: Paste it here
step3.desc: SAMII uses it to create and track your deliveries or messages automatically.
